message: The other day, I was trying to check our go-bags for any missing essentials, but my kids had other plans—turns out, they thought it was a treasure hunt! 🗺️ While they were busy ‘discovering’ snacks and toys, I realized that involving them could actually make preparing less of a chore. Now, we make it a game to see who can find the most items we need. What’s your fun family tip for getting everyone on board with preparedness?
